decisions.reason: Its proven government deployment and broad APIS connectivity make it a core, well-validated fit with our aviation and border-security business, so withdrawal risk remains very low.

Cyber security awareness training still fits our training-led integrated offer and can be cross-sold to existing clients, though it is less differentiated and easier to review out than our core operational products.

Behaviour analysis remains strategically aligned with high-risk-site security and our specialist expertise, but its likely longer adoption cycles and less visible proof of scale keep withdrawal risk moderate.
